name: Back-solve from the answer choices
definition: The answer is one of the five given. Testing a choice is often much easier than solving forwards, especially when the forward route needs algebra. Start with the middle choice so that the result tells you which direction to move.
recognizeWhen: the answer choices are all numbers
which of these numbers satisfies the condition
solving forwards needs algebra you would rather avoid
misconceptions: I started testing at choice A and worked down, which took the longest possible time.
I found a choice that satisfied one condition and stopped without checking the others.
I back-solved even though checking one choice was harder than solving the problem.
